tracks.title: メダル四万枚グランドレビュー
tracks.genre: Japanese revue show tune (Osaka all-female revue style)
tracks.subject: Yoshie, seventy-four, who has forty thousand medals banked at a game centre above an Osaka supermarket, worthless anywhere else and wiped if she stays away sixty days, so she clocks in at the coin pusher daily and tips kids a cupful like candy.
